args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- siemens.plm: PLM agents for engineering changes, BOM compliance, material provisioning
- corp.itsm: ITSM agents for IT infrastructure automation
  * ChangeAutomationOrchestrator: Automates engineering changes, material updates, product deployments
  * AssetProvisioningOrchestrator: Orchestrates IT asset lifecycle provisioning across engineering changes
- sap.odm: Canonical entity type taxonomy (EngineeringChange, ITEquipment, Material, ProductItem, etc.)
- sap.s4: ERP core (procurement matching, BOM compliance, asset lifecycle orchestration)
- sap.ariba: Procurement (vendor invoice reconciliation, supplier compliance/hazmat, material/engineering change coordination)

COST/ANALYTICS CAPABILITIES:
Searched for product cost breakdown, material expense analysis, supplier benchmarking:
- sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent: Matches requisitions to vendors based on "cost, quality, delivery"—but focuses on automation, NOT cost visibility/analysis
- No resources expose: cost breakdown by component, material expense analytics, supplier benchmarking, overpayment detection, supply chain risk quantification
- Procurement agents handle automation/compliance, not financial analysis or cost intelligence

CONCLUSION: Cost analysis and supplier benchmarking capability is absent from this landscape.
